_comment: Default configuration for the feeds addon. Override any key in app-custom-config.json. Sources are ngdpbase.addons.feeds.sources.<id>.*; see docs/managers/FeedManager.md.
_comment_max_concurrent_ingests: #1955 — how many due sources ingest at the same time. A slow or hanging source holds one slot until its timeout, so the others still run. A whole number > 0.
_comment_timeout_range: #1955 — the range, in ms, a source's timeoutMs must fall in. A value outside it is refused at startup with a warning, and the source keeps the 30 s default.
